## Workload

Kofi Asante completed 852 reads during 465 rostered hours. This represents a recorded rate of 1.8 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed in relation to the time available and the volume completed. The figures provide the basis for considering both the amount of work undertaken and the quality findings set out below.

## Quality

A sample of 62 reads was checked. Agreement was recorded at 53.2 per cent. The review included feedback on borderline background cases, with the findings considered alongside the overall workload. This supports continued attention to consistency in cases where the interpretation may be less clear.

The review was completed by Priya Anand.
